description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Lang' that validates the 'lang' attribute in HTML, ensuring it conforms to RFC 3066 language code standards. It includes logic to parse and validate language subtags according to their length and character composition.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Lang
classes.description: A class responsible for validating the 'lang' attribute in HTML elements, ensuring compliance with RFC 3066 language code format.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input 'string' as a language code according to RFC 3066, parsing subtags and ensuring they adhere to length and character constraints.
